findings: Layout masking is the win, and free: PP-DocLayoutV3 finds the notation (as 'image' — its classes have no music), and dropping the non-prose lines in those regions takes precision 76% → 96% and CER 56% → 14%. On the arranging chapter CER goes 82% → 10%.
Keep prose lines inside the regions: dropping whole regions costs 6 points of recall (labels like 旋律音位置：, a TIP paragraph printed inside an example).
The 3 points of recall the mask gives up are mostly score text the reference transcribed — 'A blues', 'Riff 2', 'D.S. al Coda', 'BEAT:' — nothing the TOC digest, tagging or Q&A use.
The CDLA layout model is half the time (0.74 vs 1.41 s/page with OCR) and within a point of V3.

Re-reading unsure lines barely moves anything: only 62 lines on 26 pages score under 0.85. DeepSeek fixed an upside-down paragraph and broke one page (+0.3 F1, $0.0017/page, 10 s/page). Sonnet 5 changed 37 lines, made 3 pages worse, and refused one call (stop_reason: refusal) on that upside-down paragraph.

Text-only correction makes pages worse: better on 1, worse on 5, and on the arranging chapter recall falls 95% → 86% as the model drops lines. Without the image it cannot tell an OCR error from the book.
Pick for the scan: PP-OCRv6 tiny + PP-DocLayoutV3, notation lines dropped (CDLA if 0.7 s/page matters). Re-read and correction: no. Calibration §12.
findings_zh: 版面检测遮谱子（方案 A）是最大的收获，而且免费：PP-DocLayoutV3 把谱子当成「图片」框出来（它没有乐谱这一类），把框里不像正文的行丢掉，精确率从 76% 升到 96%，CER 从 56% 降到 14%；编曲那章 CER 从 82% 降到 10%。
框里像正文的行要保留：整块丢掉会多丢 6 个点的召回（「旋律音位置：」这类标签、印在谱例里的整段 TIP）。
遮挡后召回少的 3 个点，大多是印在谱子上的标注（A blues、Riff 2、D.S. al Coda、BEAT:），标准答案把它们当文字转写了；对目录、打标签、问答都没用。
CDLA 版面模型快一倍（连 OCR 每页 0.74 秒对 1.41 秒），效果只差不到一个点。
重读没把握的行几乎没用：26 页只有 62 行置信度低于 0.85。DeepSeek 修好了一段倒印的文字、也弄坏了一页（F1 +0.3，每页 $0.0017、10 秒）；Sonnet 5 改了 37 行、3 页变差，还在那段倒印文字上拒绝回答了一次。
纯文字纠错让结果变差：1 页变好、5 页变差，编曲那章召回从 95% 掉到 86%（模型删了行）。它看不到原图，分不清 OCR 错字和书本原文。
扫描阶段的选择：PP-OCRv6 tiny + PP-DocLayoutV3，只丢谱子行（嫌慢就用 CDLA）。重读和纠错都不要。详见 calibration §12。
